<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><meta name="theme-color" content="#F5F0E6"><title>MOKI — Trade scrolling for living.</title><style>
:root{--ivory:#F5F0E6;--paper:#FCF8F0;--forest:#0F3527;--ink:#151A17;--muted:#657168;--orange:#D96A2B;--lime:#C7E62E;--line:rgba(15,53,39,.14);--shadow:0 20px 65px img{position:absolute;inset:-4%;width:108%;height:108%}.heroPic:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent em{display:block;background:var(--lime);color:#172218;font-style:normal;text-align:center;font-size:9px;font-weight:950;padding:8px;border-radius:10px;margin-top:9px}.section{padding:64px img{object-position:65% 55%}.moment:nth-child(3) .img img{object-position:30% 48%}.moment .copy{padding:13px}.moment b{color:var(--forest);font-size:16px}.moment p{font-size:10px;line-height:1.45;color:#6b7770;margin:5px 0 0}.loop{margin-top:25px;background:var(--forest);border-radius:27px;padding:13px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:7px;color:white}.step{border-radius:17px;padding:13px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);min-height:135px}.num{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--lime);color:#172218;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:950;margin-bottom:18px}.step h3{font-size:29px;line-height:1;margin:7px 0}.quest p{font-size:11px;line-height:1.5;color:#d4dfd8;max-width:480px}.quest ease}.reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}.overlay{position:fixed;z-index:50;inset:0;background:rgba(8,26,18,.68);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);display:none;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center}.overlay.open{display:flex}.sheet{width:min(100%,570px);max-height:92svh;overflow:auto;background:var(--paper);border-radius:27px h3{font-size:28px;line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:var(--forest);margin:0 0 7px}.sheet p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.5;color:var(--muted)}.options{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:7px;margin:16px 0}.opt{min-height:54px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;background:#fffaf4;text-align:left;padding:10px;font-weight:850;color:var(--forest)}.opt.selected{background:#eef5cc;border-color:#b5cd33}.sheet .primary{width:100%}.progress{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-bottom:17px}.progress i{height:4px;background:#d9d3c8;border-radius:4px;flex:1}.progress i.on{background:var(--forest)}.questCard{background:var(--forest);color:white;border-radius:22px;padding:20px;margin:12px 0}.questCard h4{font-size:24px;margin:7px 0}.questCard p{color:#d6dfd9}.timer{text-align:center;padding:18px 0}.timerNum{font-size:68px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:-.06em;color:var(--forest)}.reflect{display:grid;gap:7px}.reflect button{height:50px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;background:#fffaf4;color:var(--forest);font-weight:850}.founding{background:#e7dfc9;border-radius:20px;padding:17px}.price{font-size:31px;font-weight:950;color:var(--forest)}.toast{position:fixed;z-index:100;left:50%;bottom:20px;transform:translate(-50%,15px);opacity:0;background:var(--forest);color:white;padding:9px 13px;border-radius:999px;font-size:10px;transition:.18s}.toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}
@media(max-width:720px){.hero{display:flex;flex-direction:column-reverse;min-height:auto;padding:0 0 42px}.heroPic{height:430px;min-height:430px;border-radius:0 0 27px 27px;margin:0 -18px 20px;width:calc(100% + 36px);box-shadow:none}h1{font-size:49px}.lead{font-size:15px}.join{display:grid}.micro{text-align:center}.section{padding:54px 0}h2{font-size:39px}.moments{grid-template-columns:1fr}.moment{display:grid;grid-template-columns:42% 58%;min-height:140px}.moment .img{height:140px}.moment .copy{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center}.loop{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.life{display:flex;overflow:auto;margin-left:-18px;margin-right:-18px;padding:0 18px 8px;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory}.lifePhoto{flex:0 0 78vw;height:350px;scroll-snap-align:start}.quest{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.finalPic{min-height:520px}.finalCopy{padding:24px 17px}.finalCopy .join{display:grid}}@media(max-width:380px){h1{font-size:44px}.heroPic{height:390px;min-height:390px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}}
